scenes: Why is heat harder on older bodies?
With age, thirst fades and the body sweats less, | so it cools more slowly, | and the heart works harder to shed heat.
In Kolkata, older people in an informal settlement were four point three times more likely to face dangerous heat | than older people in a nearby village, because their homes stayed hot at night.
Heat is most dangerous at home, at night, | where the walls hold the day’s heat and no one is there to notice.
A cooler room, and someone who checks in.
